method.name: milp_direct_integer
steps: Define 4 integer decision variables: x_truck, x_airplane, x_boat, x_train (nonnegative integers)
Constraint 3 (no truck+train together): introduce binary y ∈ {0,1}; x_truck <= M*y, x_train <= M*(1-y) for large M (e.g. M=100)
Use HiGHS MILP solver, retrieve integer optimal solution

method.name: milp_binary_selection
steps: Define 4 production variables: x_truck, x_airplane, x_boat, x_train (nonnegative integers)
Define 4 binary selection variables: s_truck, s_airplane, s_boat, s_train ∈ {0,1}
Link production to selection via big-M: x_i <= M_i * s_i for each product

method.name: milp_lp_relaxation_then_round
steps: Solve LP relaxation (continuous variables) of the full MILP
Round integer variables to nearest integers while maintaining constraints
Apply logical constraints: if truck>0 then train=0, if boat>0 then airplane>0, boat<=train
Use simple rounding with constraint repair for feasibility
